GAB.note: ANINF hosting of RSU data is a stated future provision, with no rule or delivered hosting stated.
Biometric identification is only planned for the RSU; no national ID system is described.
ANINF's role in building and hosting is a roadmap, not delivered; nothing states a system run or gone live.
Integration with legacy and government databases is planned only; no link is contracted, built or in use.
Describes a registry, not a programme management information system.

facts.fact: TechReviewAfrica reports ANINF's roadmap for the Unified Social Registry (RSU) starts with development of a specialized social protection information system, in three implementation phases agreed with the Minister of Women, Family and Child Protection and World Bank representatives.
